title: Fuse P104 late delivery with residual cleanup for two actual consumers
body:
## Result

This source-bound fusion combines PR3981's actual copy-free late FULL delivery with PR3943's compressed query cleanup, using two actual correction consumers. It preserves all 280 input-column identities, endpoint rows and formal frames, and all 72 arbitrary dirty helper returns.

| Matched complete module | Before unit ADDs | After unit ADDs | Halves / doubles each | Native mass |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| PR3882 encoded correction | 5472 | **4704** | 2616 | **2520** |
| PR3940 fused source-preserving correction | 5856 | **5088** | 2712 | **2520** |

Each word saves exactly **768 unit ADDs**, with no extra scaling, native transport, private storage, or unpaid donor restoration. The source-preserving variant returns every X=x at FULL and every Y=x+y in its indexed hyperplane; it avoids the separate post-encoding adapter's extra192 native mass. These are matched constructive invoices, not scalar optima.

## Actual chronology and evidence

The original final416 query-cleanup events define D. Exact extraction verifies `D=T[I B]`, where T has32 coefficients ±2. After the actual late deliveries and donor normalization are complete, `Q=h−Dx`. The PR3882 correction creates `q=x_J+B x_N` in persistent FULL residuals. In the PR3940 source-preserving tail, q exists at the exact internal cut after1360 tail operations excluding the already-paid104 lifts—after every scatter donor is restored and before the inverse pivot stream removes q. At either legal cut,64 read-only unit ADDs implement `Q+=Tq`, replacing832 old cleanup ADDs.

- A new exact Fraction evaluator runs the entire joined words on280 independent inputs and verifies actual cut rows, residual donors, FULL arithmetic availability, endpoint frames, and every dirty return.
- Each variant's complete chronological native transport subsequence is literally identical to its own matched reference. Prior native phase evidence and final physical/global/all-size qualifications remain inherited; no fresh native recipe audit is claimed.
- Eight actual semantic faults reject, including incorrect cleanup timing, an unrestored quartered donor, wrong source-consumption ordering, and source-preserving cleanup after q is destroyed.
- Seven actual optimized CLI corruption fixtures each pass a positive baseline before rejecting Boolean/float receipt values, duplicate keys, false savings, changed/missing source, or changed frozen predecessor bytes.
- Separate AI peer inspection and bounded reproduction passed; it reuses this evaluator and frozen builders, so it is not represented as a second independent implementation or human/formal review.

The unchanged conditional PR3954 two-axis gate still fails by32448. Scalar fusion changes no native quantity. New global caller hypotheses are separate tasks; there is no supplier admission, all-size theorem, selected-frontier change, or new kappa claim.

The verifier authenticates original Git blobs as well as exact bytes; main-only exports require no unavailable unmerged history.

The full702-open-PR body snapshot at08:30:14UTC and a fresh latest100 update check found no equivalent fusion. The helper lacks a Discussion cache; the root coordinator separately checked live boards and posted the scoped claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3954#issuecomment-6263112891 . Main remained unchanged at the publication checkpoint. This is bounded overlap evidence, not a novelty certificate.
